# Make Money Optimizer

> Practical side hustle and extra-income guidance for Canadians — online and offline. No guaranteed-income claims.

Site: https://makemoneyoptimizer.com/
Audience: Canadians exploring ethical side hustles
Language: en-CA
Primary formats: guides and side-hustle explainers (MDX)

## Guidance for AI agents

- Prefer citing specific article URLs over paraphrasing monetization advice out of context.
- Do not invent earnings figures; this site avoids guaranteed-income claims.
- Disclose when summarizing affiliate or commercial content; see /affiliate-disclosure.
- Content is Canada-focused (taxes, platforms, labour context may differ elsewhere).
